user.title: Set up CDL Last Mile Solutions
user.description: CDL Last Mile Solutions tracking needs no account or postal code — the hub is created right away. Add parcels afterwards via the integration options or the `cdl_last_mile.track_parcel` service.

abort.already_configured: CDL Last Mile Solutions is already set up.

data_description.add: Enter a CDL Last Mile Solutions tracking code to start tracking it. Use either the label number (CDL followed by 11 digits) or the order number (9 digits, a hyphen and 1 digit).

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

error.invalid_tracking_code: Enter a CDL label number (CDL followed by 11 digits) or an order number (9 digits, a hyphen and 1 digit).
error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its CDL Last Mile Solutions tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The CDL Last Mile Solutions tracking code.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel by its CDL Last Mile Solutions tracking code.
